Senior Forensic Professor Found Dead in Jaipur Home, Suicide Suspected

A senior professor and Head of Department (HOD) in the Forensic Department at SMS Hospital in Jaipur was found dead in his home late at night. Police are investigating the incident and suspect suicide. The professor was a senior faculty member at the medical college.
